question: Should Discord role mentions become explicit wake triggers, and should the contract be an explicit configured role-ID list rather than all bot-held roles or the broader access-list redesign?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds a shipped Discord config surface and decides how role-addressed fan-out behaves in multi-agent guilds.

options.title: Add Explicit Trigger Roles
options.body: Add a narrow guild/channel trigger-role list that turns matching mentioned role IDs into a wake mention while keeping sender roles as access control.

options.title: Fold Into Access Redesign
options.body: Keep this blocked until the broader Discord bypass/mention/deny model in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/69748 defines role semantics.

options.title: Decline Role Wake Triggers
options.body: Keep direct user mentions and @everyone/@here only, and document role mentions as non-wake metadata.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Trigger Roles
recommendation.body: Add a narrow guild/channel trigger-role list that turns matching mentioned role IDs into a wake mention while keeping sender roles as access control.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across the Discord mention-policy and config surfaces involved in this decision.
